unit: dots (4 per machine cycle) after the CPU LCDC write's effect

programs.frame: HRAM $FF80: ld a,1 / ldh [$90],a / halt / ldh a,[$90] / and a / jr nz,halt / end: jr end; $40: jp $0200 -> push af / xor a / ldh [$90],a / pop af / reti; $48: jp $0210 -> the cartridge LCDC handler with hLCDCPointer ($91) = 0; LCDC $E3, WY 144, STAT $08 when IE has bit 1; IME on and IF cleared at entry
programs.vector: IE 3, STAT $08, IME off: ei / nop at eiDot
programs.ifclear: IE 3, STAT $08, IME off, IF cleared: xor a / ldh [rIF],a at dot
programs.seq: LCD off, IE 1, IF 1 pending; ei: ei/nop/nop/nop; reti: reti to a nop; di-pending: di/nop/jr

stepFormat.dispatch: [kind, startDot, dots, vector 1=VBlank 2=STAT, IF after, PC before (0xff84 HALT retry, 0xff85 after HALT)]
stepFormat.seq: [PC, dots, PC after, IME after, IF bit 0 after]
